# Code Regime Technologies
Code Regime Technologies is a software development company based in Madurai, Tamil Nadu, India. It provides custom software, web app, mobile app, enterprise, blockchain, and ready-made clone script solutions for startups, businesses, and enterprises.

## Products and Solutions

CabRegime — Uber Clone
CabRegime is a taxi and ride-hailing platform with secure payments, real-time ride tracking, and driver management capabilities.
- [Product](https://www.coderegimetechnologies.com/uber-clone/)

FoodRegime — Ubereats Clone
FoodRegime is a food delivery platform connecting customers, restaurants, and delivery partners with real-time tracking.
- [Product](https://www.coderegimetechnologies.com/ubereats-clone/)

HandymanRegime
HandymanRegime is an on-demand home services marketplace connecting customers with service professionals.
- [Product](https://www.coderegimetechnologies.com/uber-for-handyman-app/)

Insurance Software
Code Regime Technologies provides insurance software focused on policy management, claims processing, automation, and customer-facing digital experiences.
- [Product](https://www.coderegimetechnologies.com/insurance-software/)

Fintech App Development
Code Regime Technologies provides fintech application development and financial software solutions.
- [Service](https://www.coderegimetechnologies.com/fintech-app-development/)

Flight Booking App Development
FlightBooking is a flight ticket booking platform designed for travel and flight booking businesses.
- [Product](https://www.coderegimetechnologies.com/flight-booking-app/)
